description: Shared Renovate rules of the VPS apps (see rael06/vps, docs/architecture.md). Public on purpose: the Mend-hosted Renovate app does not let a public repository read a preset from a private one. Each repository extends github>rael06/renovate-config.

schedule: before 7am on the first day of the month

packageRules.description: Major updates of these legacy stacks wait for an approval in the Dependency Dashboard issue.
One weekly pull request for the non-major npm updates, merged by hand (merging deploys).
GitHub Actions and pinned tools: non-major updates merge themselves once the checks pass.
kamal-proxy is shared and only changes version on a reboot: no automerge; reboot by hand after merging.
prBodyNotes: After merging: Actions → CI/CD → Run workflow on the default branch with « Reboot kamal-proxy » checked (a few seconds of outage).

customManagers.description: Kamal version installed by the workflows.
Wrangler version used by the workflows and the config schema.
Tagged images of the Kamal accessories (the app image itself has no tag). A change applies with `kamal accessory reboot <name>`.
kamal-proxy version shared by every app (proxy: run: version:).
Trivy image of the weekly security scan.
